svg.aria-label: Two red snakes eat contributions; two blue snakes restore them along independent randomized routes
svg.title: Contribution snakes — two eat, two restore
svg.desc: Independent experiment based on https://github.com/Platane/snk. Two red snakes eat in parallel; two blue snakes restore original colors behind their tails. Shared grid, independent randomized body-safe paths, original movement speed, right-side vertical progress gauges.

g.aria-label: Vertical snake progress: red collecting and blue restoring

svg.desc: 2,136 contributions in the last year. Months and Mon, Wed, Fri labels follow the GitHub calendar.
